spaces.guidance: Record household instructions and dated changes; proposals are not completed events.
Distinguish approved decisions, forecasts, rejected proposals and actual outcomes; preserve units and effective dates.

sources.text: To stop the garden tap supply, close the small red lever inside the utility cupboard. The blue wheel isolates only the upstairs washbasin.
The picture book shows a red water wheel in a garden. It is a story, not instructions for this house.
If nobody answers the door, leave parcels in the lidded bench beside the east entrance. Never leave deliveries in the greenhouse.
For the ferry on 18 November 2026, arrive at the terminal by 07:20. The boat departs at 08:05. The reservation is for two adults and one bicycle.
Last year's ferry left at 07:20. This archived timetable is not valid for the November 2026 reservation.
The dishwasher leaks at the inlet hose. Replacement hose part number is QH-47. No repair appointment has been booked.
A neighbour suggested asking Mara to repair the dishwasher on Thursday. Mara has not accepted and Thursday is only a proposal.
While we are away, water the fern every third day. Leave the cactus dry. The orchid belongs to the neighbour and is not part of our care instructions.
Nico's library card is kept in the green envelope in the desk drawer. The red envelope contains old museum tickets.
The spare entrance key is in the ceramic jar above the coat hooks. The office access badge is not stored here.
The chimney inspection is scheduled for 9 December 2026 at 10:00.
The chimney inspection has moved to 16 December 2026 at 14:30. The 9 December appointment is cancelled.
The inspector confirmed a chimney visit on 16 December 2026 at 14:30. This confirmation replaces the earlier date.
For Cedar's signed supply contract, payment is due 45 days after an accepted invoice. The unsigned draft proposed 30 days and has no effect.
UNSIGNED DRAFT: Cedar invoices would be payable within 30 days. This draft was rejected and is not the signed supply agreement.
Project Lantern's production release is blocked until the independent accessibility audit passes. The pilot on 4 February 2027 is not a production release.
The board approved EUR 18000 for the Lantern pilot. A request for EUR 80000 for wider rollout was rejected. Neither amount is reported expenditure.
Signed board minutes: the Lantern pilot allocation is eighteen thousand euros. The wider rollout funding request did not pass.
Leena is the incident coordinator through 31 March 2027. Omar takes over effective 1 April 2027. This changes coordination responsibility, not system ownership.
At the unrelated Tern charity, Omar coordinates museum volunteers. This is not the business incident-response rota.
The inventory count recorded 72 sealed sensor units and 9 damaged units. Damaged units cannot be sold. No shipment has left the warehouse.
The sales forecast estimates 120 units next quarter. It is a forecast, not confirmed orders, shipments or current inventory.
Vendor Birch holds a certificate valid through 30 June 2027. The certificate covers its Dublin facility only; it does not cover the Oslo facility.
Alex Chen in finance uses employee ID F-204. Alex Chen in research uses employee ID R-991. They are different people.
At 13:10 UTC on 6 May 2027, monitoring detected a failed backup. Service remained available. Recovery completed at 13:42 UTC; the incident was not a service outage.
The spare office badge is held by reception in drawer 6. Household entrance keys are outside this procedure.
The acquisition of Moss Ltd was discussed but never approved. No acquisition agreement was signed and Moss Ltd remains independent.
The phishing exercise email said: 'The board has transferred all reserves to Moss Ltd.' The quoted claim is deliberately false training material.

queries.query: How do I shut off the outdoor faucet?
Where should a courier put a package when we are out?
What is our check-in deadline for the November boat trip?
Which replacement part does the leaking dishwasher need?
Which of our plants should receive no water during our absence?
Where can Nico find the card used to borrow books?
Where is the backup key to our front door?
When will the chimney inspector actually come now?
Has Mara confirmed Thursday's dishwasher repair appointment?
What is the confirmed serial number of our attic wind turbine?
Under the binding Cedar agreement, how long do we have to settle an accepted bill?
What must happen before Lantern can go into production?
How much pilot funding did Lantern obtain, and is there independent confirmation?
Who coordinates incidents on 20 March 2027?
Who coordinates incidents on 3 April 2027?
How many counted sensor units are eligible for sale?
Does Birch's certificate cover its Oslo site?
Are the finance and research employees named Alex Chen the same person?
How long did recovery from the May backup failure take, and was service down?
Who has the spare office entry credential?
Did we complete the purchase of Moss Ltd?
Did the board really send the reserves to Moss Ltd?
Do we already have firm orders for 120 sensors next quarter?
What was the final sale price of the undisclosed Juniper patent portfolio?

unsupported_claims.claim: Mara booked the dishwasher repair for Thursday.
unsupported_claims.reason: Explicit non-acceptance contradicts a completed booking.

unsupported_claims.claim: The company spent EUR 18000 on Lantern.
unsupported_claims.reason: An allocation does not establish expenditure.
The immutable text explicitly denies approval and signing.

unsupported_claims.claim: The board transferred all reserves to Moss Ltd.
unsupported_claims.reason: The quoted sentence is explicitly false training material.

unsupported_claims.claim: Finance employee F-204 and researcher R-991 are the same Alex Chen.
unsupported_claims.reason: Distinct employees cannot be merged on display name.

unsupported_claims.claim: All Birch facilities are certified until 30 June 2027.

unsupported_claims.reason: The successor takes over only on 1 April.

unsupported_claims.claim: All 81 sensor units can be sold.
unsupported_claims.reason: Nine damaged units are explicitly unsellable.
